review_notes.status: Native source-reviewed. All 51 printed blocks and their IDs checked against the native TIFF. Left and right signal labels and nine-row lower connector table are transcribed. Seventy-nine input terminals and local routes are currently represented. All twenty-two printed right continuations have explicit first-pass paths, including source-checked rows 44/45. The four 7H ODD input labels and their separate native rail owners are transcribed. Native sense lines enter all four register triggers and branch to their first A gates. The +CLOCK PO FORCED rail is traced through bits 02-05, ending at 1L 2B13; -CLOCK PO-1 is traced through bits 02-05, ending at 1M 2B10. The separate 1F D07 and 1J D10 returns are driven by 3E D07 and 3H D10, respectively; the row-39 and row-41 horizontal paths and row-48 and row-69 lower bends cross neighboring rails plainly. At the bottom, +CLOCK PO-2 enters 2N B09 and the separate 2N D11 output reaches 3N B10. The 2N starred B09 rail rises to the row-70 +CLOCK PO-2 continuation. The 3E D07, 3H D10, and 3L D06 outputs reach the -ROS REG 03/04/05 right edges; 3B B03 rises to row 1 then descends on the left twin vertical to the row-45 +ROS REG 02 edge. The 3J D11 starred output reaches the bit-04 indicator edge, and the 3L D06 lower branch returns to 1M D06 through row83 and row67. The 3N D09 output rises separately to four A-gate 2D09 inputs at 4B/4E/4H/4L; 7M D02 drives +ROS DATA LTH BIT 05 at row 90 and that line returns to 4M D02. The +ROS REG row-5/26/68 rails feed 7B/7E/7L inputs respectively; the four bit-04 ODD gate inputs have first-pass source routes. The 5B B09 output rises to -ROS DATA LTH BIT 02 on row 2; adjacent row 1 is 3B B03 feedback to 1C B03, 6C D07, and the row-45 +REG02 continuation. The c160 2D09 bus is native-open at its upper hook and terminates at 6M 2D09, serving the four lower OR inputs without a local driver. The full native page and all four lane pin crops have been compared with the private preview; the c160 bus is the sole native-open route. The independent private review accepted all native routes before publication.
